project_type: Go CLI + REST API + Web UI vulnerability intelligence tool
test_framework: go test with build tag integration for integration tests, testcontainers for DB tests
verification_instructions: 1. Run go build ./... to verify compilation. 2. Run go test ./... -count=1 -short to run unit tests.
environment_constraints: No PostgreSQL available for integration tests. Unit tests only. No Docker daemon available.
contribution_requirements: Follow Go conventions, use database/sql standard interface, run fmt and lint before push
key_patterns: Store methods on *PostgresStore. Ingest pipeline uses type assertion against local interfaces (epssBatchStore, epssBackfillStore) to access store methods not in main Store interface. Coverage page checks epss_daily_stats table. Backfill skip logic checks epss_scores table via GetEPSSImportedDates.
directory_structure: cmd/mayu/ (CLI entrypoints), internal/ingest/ (pipeline orchestrators), internal/store/ (PostgreSQL persistence), internal/fetcher/ (HTTP data fetchers), internal/server/ (REST API), migrations/ (SQL migrations)
